defs.def: a male parent of a child or an animal; a person who is acting as the father to a child 父亲；爸爸

ex.s: My dad and I were at a grocery store last evening.
ex.t: 当收银员扫描完所有商品后，爸爸伸手去拿钱包，却愣住了。

ex.s: When the cashier rang everything up, my dad reached for his wallet and froze.
ex.t: 当收银员把所有东西扫码结算后，我爸爸伸手去拿钱包，却愣住了。

ex.s: There was a silence as Dad continued to drink his tea, and I held my breath.
ex.t: 当爸爸继续喝他的茶时，一阵沉默，我屏住了呼吸。

ex.s: I breathed a huge sigh of relief: I had expected sadness, maybe even doubt, but Dad was already looking to the future.
ex.t: 我长长地松了一口气：我本以为会是伤感，甚至可能是疑虑，但爸爸已经在展望未来。

ex.s: At home, my dad said, "A job’s a big step to growing up.
ex.t: 在家里，父亲说：“工作是人成长的一大步。”

ex.t: 我很高兴你能为这个家庭贡献力量。” 我父亲的话让我意识到，我的收入可能不是按我的意愿来支付的。

ex.s: “Let's make a cake for Dad!” I cried.
ex.t: “我们给爸爸做个蛋糕吧！”我喊道。

ex.s: Her dad worked at a job away from the farm, and her mother ran the farm with the kids.
ex.t: 她父亲在农场以外的地方工作，母亲和孩子们一起经营农场。

ex.s: She helped her dad with his work.
ex.t: 帮助父亲工作。

ex.s: For example, every morning, my dad has to have the bowl of egg soup while I had to eat an apple.
ex.t: 例如，每天早上，我爸爸都要喝那碗蛋花汤，而我必须吃一个苹果。

ex.s: My dad don’t like the soup and I don’t enjoy apples.
ex.t: 爸爸不喜欢那碗汤，我也不喜欢苹果。

ex.s: Researchers from Brigham Young University discovered that fathers are in a unique position to help their adolescent children learn persistence.
ex.t: 来自Brigham Young大学的研究人员发现，父亲们在帮助青少年子女学习持久性方面处于独特的地位。

ex.s: And over time, the persistence gained through fathers led to higher achievement in school.
ex.t: 随着时间的推移，从父亲那里获得的毅力带来了更高的学业成就。

ex.s: “There are relatively few studies that stress the unique role of fathers,” Padilla-Walker said.
ex.t: "强调父亲独特作用的研究相对较少，"Padilla-Walker说。

ex.s: Researchers determined that dads need to practice an “authoritative” parenting style.
ex.t: 研究人员确定，爸爸们需要实践一种'权威型'育儿风格。

ex.t: 「我们该怎么做才能让波比振作起来呢？」爸爸问道。

ex.t: 爸爸打开箱子，一只可爱的小狗出现了。

ex.t: "看到了吗，爸爸？"Ponder喊道。

ex.s: I mention the single parent with four kids running the show and I talk about the dad coaching a team that his kids aren’t even on … At this point the unwilling parent speaks up,“Alright.
ex.t: 我提到那位带着四个孩子独撑局面的单亲家长，也谈到那位给根本不是自己孩子的球队当教练的父亲……这时，那位不情愿的家长开口了：“好吧。

ex.s: It all began when Moore visited a bank with her dad.
ex.t: 这一切始于摩尔和父亲去银行办事。

ex.s: So she desired to get round the warning, "Why can't I make a healthy candy that's good for my teeth so that my parents can't say no to it?" With that in mind, Moore asked her dad if she could start her own candy company.
ex.t: 于是她渴望避开这个警告：'为什么我不能做一种对牙齿有益的健康糖果，这样我父母就不会拒绝它呢？'带着这个想法，Moore 问她父亲她是否能创办自己的糖果公司。

ex.s: How did Moore react to her dad's warning?
ex.t: Moore对爸爸的警告有何反应？

ex.s: It was summer, and my dad wanted to treat me to a vacation like never before.
ex.t: 那是夏天，爸爸想带我去度一个前所未有的特别假期，好好犒赏我。

ex.s: Uncle Paul, my dad’s friend, picked us up from the airport and drove us up to his farm in Pecos.
ex.t: 爸爸的朋友保罗叔叔从机场接上我们，开车送我们到了他在佩科斯的农场。

ex.s: My dad and I spent the night in the guestroom of the farm house listening to the frogs and water rolling down the river nearby.
ex.t: 看到爸爸和叔叔保罗骑马让我印象深刻。

ex.s: I was impressed to see my dad and Uncle Paul riding horses.
ex.t: 看到爸爸和保罗叔叔骑马，给我留下了深刻的印象。

ex.s: In the afternoon, I asked Uncle Paul if I could take a hose ride, and he said yes, as long as my dad went with me.
ex.t: 下午，我问保罗叔叔我能不能骑马，他同意了，条件是我爸爸陪我一起去。

ex.s: "Don’t be late for supper," Uncle Paul cried, "and keep to the track so that you don’t get lost!" "OK! " my dad cried back.
ex.t: “晚饭别迟到了，”保罗叔叔喊道，“沿着小路走，这样你们就不会迷路！”“好的！”我爸爸大声回应。

ex.s: Sarah says, “My dad thinks I should take the offer now.
ex.t: Sarah说："我爸觉得我现在应该接受这个offer。

ex.s: Dad said she was probably lonely, and that I ought to sit and listen and nod my head and smile, and maybe she’d work it out of her system.
ex.t: 爸爸说她可能很孤独，我应该坐下来倾听、点点头、微笑，也许她能把心里的郁闷发泄出来。

ex.s: So that’s what I did, and it turned out Dad was right.
ex.t: 于是我就这么做了，结果证明爸爸是对的。

ex.s: He tried to please his dad
ex.t: 他试图取悦他爸爸

ex.s: To our great relief, Dad turned down the idea.
ex.t: 令我们大为欣慰的是，爸爸拒绝了这个想法。

ex.s: Like Father, Like Son (The living room.
ex.t: 如父亲，如儿子(客厅).

ex.s: Grandfather and Father, seated at the table, are playing chess.) Grandfather: And...I win!
ex.t: 坐在桌旁的爷爷和父亲正在下棋。）爷爷：还有……我赢了！

ex.s: (Son enters room.) Father: Not again!
ex.t: （儿子进了房间。）父亲：别又来了！

ex.s: Son: (nervously approaching the table) Erm...Dad, can we talk?
ex.t: 儿子： （紧张地走近桌子）呃……爸爸，我们能谈谈吗？

ex.s: You know you can always turn to your dad for a chat.
ex.t: 你知道你总是可以找爸爸聊聊天的。

ex.s: For the past ten years, my dad and I have attended the same school — he as an administrator and I as a student.
ex.t: 在过去的十年里，我和我爸爸在同一所学校上学——他是一个行政人员，我是一个学生。

ex.s: A few days later, I came back with my first jars of zero waste groceries, and my dad commented on how silly it was for me to carry jars everywhere.
ex.t: 几天后，我带着第一批零浪费杂货罐回来，我爸爸评论说，我到处带着罐子真是傻。

ex.s: Perhaps the first thing that springs to mind when you think of storytelling is the fantasy land that took shape in your mind while Mom or Dad told you stories about princes, castles and monsters, with a unique voice for each character.
ex.t: 想到讲故事，你脑海中浮现的第一件事，或许是爸妈用各自的嗓音为你讲王子、城堡和怪兽的故事时，你心中形成的幻想世界。

ex.s: “I thought, in this family, we don’t compare ourselves with other people, Dad?” the teenager replied.
ex.t: "我以为，在这个家里，我们不和别人攀比呢，爸爸？"那个少年回答道。

ex.t: 而他的爸爸，阿尔伯特，拿走了我爸挣来的钱，用它来支付家庭开支。

ex.s: With her dad's permission, she spent the next two years researching online and conducting trials to get a recipe that was both tasty and tooth-friendly.
ex.t: 在她父亲的允许下，她花了两年时间在网上进行研究，并进行试验，以获得一种既美味又方便牙齿的食谱。

ex.s: In my ninth-grade writing class last year, I met a cowboy who saved his town, a strict father who demanded his son earn straight A’s, and a modern-day Juliet who died of heartbreak after her parents rejected the love of her young life.
ex.t: 去年在我九年级的写作课上，我遇到了一个拯救了小镇的牛仔、一个要求儿子门门得A的严厉父亲，以及一个在现代版朱丽叶——她在父母拒绝了她年轻生命中的挚爱后，因心碎而死。

ex.t: 他母亲在上班，父亲出差了。

ex.t: 我父母以前住在这里，我父亲的手表也在这里，”他一边解释，一边试着撬起一块地板。

ex.s: In the headmaster’s office, my father listened attentively, and then spoke with quiet authority: “I trust my son.
ex.t: 在校长办公室里，父亲专注地听着，然后以沉静的威严说道：“我相信我的儿子。”

ex.t: 要不是听到父亲那鼓励我、为我加油的喊声，我早就放弃了。

ex.s: In the study, about 52 percent of the dads exhibited above-average levels of authoritative parenting. key finding is that over time, children raised by an authoritative father were significantly more likely to develop persistence, which leads to better outcomes in school.
ex.t: 在这项研究中，约52%的父亲表现出高于平均水平的权威型育儿方式。关键发现是，随着时间的推移，由权威型父亲抚养的孩子明显更有可能培养出毅力，从而在学校取得更好的成绩。

ex.t: 在我们旅行结束时，我告诉父亲我计划每两年回来一次，但他同意了。

ex.t: 我告诉父亲，Stanley 太太说话时仿佛 Stanley 先生还活着。

ex.s: Hearing Dad’s cheerfulness, I realised that what I’d been seeing as “the end of an era” was actually the start of a new one.
ex.t: 听到爸爸的欢快，我意识到我一直视为“一个时代终结”的事情，其实是一个新时代的开始。

ex.t: 于是，我和爸爸戴上新的牛仔帽，骑上马，慢慢朝山里走去。

to create new ideas or a new way of doing sth 创立（新思想）；创造，发明（新方法）
